meta.move: No evidence: flattery, then asks for advice
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out about it on his phone in the middle of a class?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Save it. Who decided on the zero, and on what evidence?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
I'm sorry? You want me to tell you how to do your job. Take the zero off, Hale, or show me what you're basing it on.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here? What do you have, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale (cc: Principal),

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for how he found out, and that nothing about this is ever placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, agreeing to nothing and still wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because you showed no evidence, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because she only moves on a specific, dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself.
What cost ground: You asked her how you should handle the situation, which gave her nothing and made her respect you less.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero and why Owen found out on his phone, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then put a dated document from Owen's own work in front of her.
